entry.title: Netanyahu bloc first but without majority as Arab parties hold balance of power in Israel election
entry.summary: Israel faces a political deadlock after Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc fell short of the 61 seats needed for a majority. With Arab-led parties holding 19 seats, opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot could seek their support to form a government.
entry.content:
